# Daniel Freire's Portfolio — Personal Portfolio Website
> Multilingual portfolio website built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4, featuring internationalisation (6 locales), dark/light theme, contact form with Turnstile protection, and analytics integration.

## Docs
- [package.json](package.json): Project dependencies, scripts (dev, build, test, lint), and metadata
- [next.config.ts](next.config.ts): Next.js configuration (strict mode, SVG webpack loader, i18n plugin, dev origins)
- [src/config.ts](src/config.ts): Application-wide constants (port, host/base URL)
- [src/types.ts](src/types.ts): TypeScript type definitions (TechCardProps, UserLanguageType, Dictionary, NavLink, Service, etc.)
- [src/middleware.ts](src/middleware.ts): Next.js middleware for locale detection, negotiation, and redirects
- [src/i18n/routing.ts](src/i18n/routing.ts): Internationalisation routing config (6 locales, per-locale pathname overrides)
- [src/i18n/request.ts](src/i18n/request.ts): next-intl request config — locale resolution and message loading with fallback
- [src/i18n/navigation.ts](src/i18n/navigation.ts): i18n-aware navigation primitives (Link, redirect, usePathname, useRouter, getPathname)
- [src/app/sitemap.ts](src/app/sitemap.ts): Sitemap generation with hreflang alternates for all locales
- [src/app/manifest.ts](src/app/manifest.ts): Web App Manifest for PWA support (standalone display, theme colour)
- [src/app/robots.txt](src/app/robots.txt): Robots.txt — allows all crawlers, points to sitemap
- [envConfig.ts](envConfig.ts): Environment variable loader using @next/env
- [postcss.config.mjs](postcss.config.mjs): PostCSS configuration with Tailwind CSS v4 plugin and custom fade-in-up animation
- [eslint.config.mjs](eslint.config.mjs): ESLint flat config — TypeScript, React, JSX-a11y, i18n, CSS, Markdown, JSON linting
- [cypress.config.ts](cypress.config.ts): Cypress E2E test configuration with accessibility checker plugin
- [src/stores/theme-store.ts](src/stores/theme-store.ts): Zustand theme store (dark/light mode toggle)
- [src/providers/GoogleAnalytics.tsx](src/providers/GoogleAnalytics.tsx): Google Analytics 4 integration component
- [src/providers/posthog.tsx](src/providers/posthog.tsx): PostHog analytics provider (currently commented out)
- [src/providers/TurnstileServer.tsx](src/providers/TurnstileServer.tsx): Cloudflare Turnstile server-side token validation
- [src/lib/resend.ts](src/lib/resend.ts): Server action for sending contact-form emails via Resend
- [src/lib/EmailTemplate.tsx](src/lib/EmailTemplate.tsx): Welcome email React component (rendered server-side via Resend)

## Project Structure
The project follows the Next.js App Router convention with a `[locale]` dynamic segment for internationalisation.

- `/src/app/[locale]/` — Page routes (home, about, contact, portfolio, privacy-policy, 404/not-found)
- `/src/i18n/` — Internationalisation configuration (routing, navigation, request handling)
- `/src/messages/` — Translation JSON files (cz.json, de.json, dk.json, en.json, pl.json, pt.json)
- `/src/ui/Components/` — Reusable UI components (Sidenav, Carousel, ContactForm, Services, FluidCursor, CtA, etc.)
- `/src/ui/Components/svgs/` — SVG icon components (tech stack icons, animated icons)
- `/src/ui/fonts/` — Custom local font files (Mozilla Headline, IBM Plex, Fraunces, Literata, Satoshi, Titillium Web)
- `/src/providers/` — Client-side providers (Google Analytics, PostHog, CookieBanner/Turnstile)
- `/src/stores/` — Zustand state stores (theme-store)
- `/src/lib/` — Server-side utilities (email sending, data fetching)
- `/cypress/` — Cypress E2E tests (content, forms, metadata)
- `/public/` — Static assets (images, SVGs, metadata icons, Open Graph images)

## Key Technologies
- **Framework:** Next.js 15 (App Router)
- **Language:** TypeScript 5
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4, PostCSS
- **Internationalisation:** next-intl (6 locales: cz, de, dk, en, pl, pt)
- **State Management:** Zustand
- **Animation:** GSAP, Motion (Framer Motion)
- **Email:** Resend, @react-email/components
- **Form Protection:** Cloudflare Turnstile (next-turnstile)
- **Analytics:** Google Analytics 4 (GA4), PostHog (commented out)
- **Performance:** @vercel/speed-insights
- **Testing:** Vitest (unit), Cypress (E2E, accessibility)
- **Linting:** ESLint flat config with TypeScript, React, JSX-a11y, i18n, CSS, Markdown, JSON plugins
- **Package Manager:** pnpm
- **Images:** next-cloudinary, react-globe.gl (3D globe)
- **SVG:** @svgr/webpack (import SVGs as React components)
- **Fonts:** Custom local fonts (Mozilla Headline, IBM Plex Sans/Serif, Fraunces, Literata, Satoshi, Titillium Web)

## Core Features
- **Multilingual (i18n):** Full internationalisation with 6 locales, locale-aware routing with per-language pathname overrides, and translated content for all pages
- **Responsive Design:** Mobile-first layout with adaptive components (Sidenav with Dock-style navigation, carousel)
- **Dark/Light Theme:** Zustand-powered theme toggle with system preference detection and persistence
- **Contact Form:** Server-side email delivery via Resend with Cloudflare Turnstile spam protection, and multi-language welcome email template
- **Analytics:** Google Analytics 4 integration with consent-based tracking
- **Cookie Consent:** Cookie consent banner with granular analytics opt-in/out
- **Accessibility:** Comprehensive ESLint JSX-a11y rules, accessibility checker in Cypress tests
- **SEO:** Full sitemap generation with hreflang alternates, dynamic Open Graph images, metadata per page
- **Portfolio Showcase:** Project cards with filtering, external links (demo, GitHub), and Cloudinary-optimised images
- **Interactive UI:** 3D rotating globe (react-globe.gl), animated fluid cursor, GSAP animations, carousel
- **Tech Stack Display:** Visual grid of technologies with logos and links to official documentation
- **PWA Support:** Web App Manifest with standalone display mode and theme colour
- **Web Performance:** Vercel Speed Insights, optimised local fonts, SVG as React components
- **Testing:** Unit tests (Vitest) and E2E tests (Cypress) with accessibility auditing

## Pages
- **Home (/):** Landing page with carousel, tech stack grid, trending section, and call-to-action
- **About (/about):** Personal bio and background information
- **Contact (/contact):** Contact form with Turnstile protection
- **Portfolio (/portfolio):** Project and website showcase with filtering
- **Privacy Policy (/privacy-policy):** Legal privacy policy page
- **404 (/[...rest]):** Catch-all not-found page

## Environment Variables
The project uses a `.env` file loaded via @next/env (envConfig.ts). Key variables include:
- `PORT` — Application port (default: 3000)
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_resend` — Resend API key for email sending
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` — Cloudflare Turnstile secret key
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA4` — Google Analytics 4 measurement ID
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY` — PostHog API key (commented out)
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST` — PostHog host URL (commented out)
- `VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL` — Vercel deployment URL (set automatically on Vercel)

## Scripts
- `pnpm dev` — Start development server
- `pnpm build` — Production build
- `pnpm start` — Start production server
- `pnpm lint` — Run ESLint across all relevant file types
- `pnpm lint-fix` — Run ESLint with auto-fix
- `pnpm test` — Run Vitest unit tests
- `pnpm test:watch` — Run Vitest in watch mode
- `pnpm test:coverage` — Run Vitest with coverage report
- `pnpm email` — Start React Email dev server
